title: Enemy Spotted
blurb: Flat, professional, and delivered by a man about to be one-tapped through a doorway. Counter-Strike's radio callouts were designed for clarity rather than character, which is exactly why they became so quotable — nobody in real life announces a threat this calmly. It is gaming's most reusable alert. Play it when a teacher walks into the room, when an ex arrives at the party, or when the group chat's main character comes online with something to say. Threat detected, situational awareness engaged, best of luck to everyone involved.
origin: The classic radio callout from Counter-Strike.
